# Epistle of Barnabas Chapter 20 — Disagreement Log

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Agents:** EMET / LOGOS / PNEUMA

---

## Disagreement 1 — v.1: "glorified" vs. "honored"
- EMET: "will be glorified in the kingdom of God"
- LOGOS: "will be glorified in the kingdom of God"
- PNEUMA: "will be honored in God's kingdom"
- **Ruling:** "will be glorified in the kingdom of God" — *doxasthēsetai en tē basileia tou theou* — "glorified" (*doxazō*) is theologically specific; "honored" (PNEUMA) is weaker and loses the divine-glory dimension.

## Disagreement 2 — v.2: "recompense" vs. "retribution"
- EMET: "a recompense"
- LOGOS: "a retribution"
- PNEUMA: "a day of reckoning"
- **Ruling:** "a retribution" — *antapodosis* = a paying-back/retribution; in this eschatological context it means punishment for the wicked; "recompense" (EMET) is more neutral; "retribution" captures the judgment context.

## Disagreement 3 — v.3: Who is being addressed — "positions of honor" vs. "higher position" vs. "positions of leadership"
- EMET: "those who are in a higher position"
- LOGOS: "those who occupy positions of honor"
- PNEUMA: "those of you who hold positions of leadership"
- **Ruling:** "those who occupy positions of honor" — *hoi en timē* = those in honor/dignity; this does not necessarily mean leadership per se; LOGOS is closest; "higher position" (EMET) adds a hierarchical nuance; "leadership" (PNEUMA) is interpretive.

## Disagreement 4 — v.3: "put away from yourselves any one of you" vs. "push anyone away"
- EMET: "do not put away from yourselves any one of you"
- LOGOS: "do not put away any from among you"
- PNEUMA: "never push anyone away from among you"
- **Ruling:** "do not put away any from among you" — LOGOS; the concern is with exclusion from the community; "put away" is the technical term for expulsion; "push away" (PNEUMA) is more casual.

**Total disagreements: 4**
